Name: Ribeena's Vehicles
Author: ribeena
Description:
Replaces the mayors car to an old Ford style, Joja truck to an Isuzu style, the movie theatre car with a muscle style, caravan to an Australian style classic, the traveller's cart is more physically possible (less busy), Sebastian's bike (much less childish/baloony), Willy's boat to more of a fishing vessel, and the bus to a more modern look (significant changes listed below). Seasonal graphics are included on many vehicles, options to toggle whether a vehicle replacement happens can be done in config.json (I recommend using GMCM).

Significant changes to the bus for Calico desert
[list]
[*]follows seasons
[*] dilapidated state prior to unlocking
[*]door/entry moved
[*]doors open and close automatically depending on where you/Pam are (no more always open door!)
[*]animated wheels
[/list]Don't want cool animations? Just don't install "BusSpriteAdjust" and the vanilla bus will be there

Changes to Willy's boat
[list]
[*]Now gently bobs up and down (broken anchor stays in place)
[*]wider graphics (sized a bit more like a fishing boat)
[*]adjusted lights to match image
[/list]Don't want cool animations? Just don't install "BoatSpriteAdjust" and the vanilla boat will be there
[line]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue[/url]﻿ for snow etc applies automatically
[*]Earthy Recolour, Starblue style for bus etc are config options (use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿)﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1965]Elle's town creatures[/url]﻿ option for cart's pig
[*]Not [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE [/url]﻿compatible (though unclear as to why not)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2905]BusLocations[/url]﻿ partially working with [url=https://github.com/ribeena/BusLocations/releases/tag/RELEASE]unofficial update[/url]
[*]Others[list]
[*]Likely to not work with any other bus mods.
[*]Should be fine with map mods that don't change position of the bus - the bus changes modify a few tiles where the bus rests, which are targeted.
[*]Adds a sprite on LooseSprites/Cursor next to Pam driving which might cause issues
[*]Not compatible/no options for other colour palettes changers not listed above
[/list]
[/list][line]

Want to fix up BusSpriteAdjust's code? The [url=https://github.com/ribeena/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/busSpriteMod/BusSpriteAdjust]source is here[/url]... :'D Was way more complicated than I wanted (i was thinking a hundred lines of code, not 700+!)

You can get BoatSpriteAdjust's [url=https://github.com/ribeena/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/busSpriteMod/BoatSpriteMode]code here[/url].
